verdict.rationale: Otter documents cross-meeting natural-language search via Otter AI Chat, searching transcripts/summaries/notes 'across all time periods,' with meetings organized by team/project/topic and analysis of patterns across multiple meetings, which supports finding and revisiting specific moments. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of jumping to an exact timestamp/moment in a transcript from search results, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of search accuracy or completeness across large meeting histories.
